title: PPG-MS14 — Pre-Emit Safety Predicate Stack (force / spindle / workholding / thin-wall / chatter HARD BLOCK)
description: Wires the complete pre-emit safety predicate stack as a single PostProcessorPipelineEngine stage 3.5 gate. Today these predicates exist as scattered dispatcher actions but no PPG-MS gates emit on them. Tier-aware: HARD BLOCK on shop_floor when any predicate fails; WARN on sim. Provides a single explainable verdict on whether a program is safe to run on a given machine.
rationale: Operator wins, shop-management wins, and the omega tier system (PPG-MS8) all assume a coherent safety predicate exists for emit-time decisions. Today the predicates are: machine_force_limit_validate (force vs machine ceiling), spindle_torque_curve (RPM vs torque curve), workholding_verify (clamp force vs cutting force), clamping_force_calc (clamp adequacy), thin_wall_params (deflection prediction), chatter_stability_sld (stable RPM band). They are not assembled into one gate. Without this milestone, PPG-MS9 AGI gates have no predicate-level grounding.
leverage_existing: workholding_verify + workholding_verify_all + workholding_min_safety + workholding_clamp_force + workholding_pullout + workholding_liftoff (calc dispatcher)

Lathe predicates: chuck_force + tailstock + steady_rest + part_off_force + lathe_collision_check + lathe_swing_check + lathe_grooving_overhang + lathe_chip_thickness + lathe_boring_reach + lathe_g71_type + lathe_boring_taper_comp + lathe_springback_comp + lathe_chatter_analysis + lathe_drill_thrust + lathe_parting_force + lathe_beam_deflection + lathe_chip_breaking + lathe_peck_schedule (actions dual-wired: camDispatcher.ts (router) AND turningDispatcher.ts (canonical home). MS14 wires through both surfaces; tests assert action availability via either dispatcher)

WEDM predicates: wedm_safety_gate_evaluate + wedm_unit_tag_evaluate + wedm_head_clearance_evaluate + wedm_flush_adequacy_evaluate + wedm_thermal_release_evaluate + wedm_dialect_verify + wedm_predict_wire_break + wedm_assess_surface_integrity + wedm_check_spec + wedm_thin_wire_derate_summary + wedm_kerf_overcut + wedm_wire_stress_analyze + wedm_wire_tension_optimize + wedm_wire_heating_safe_params (actions dual-wired: camDispatcher.ts (router) AND edmDispatcher.ts (canonical home). MS14 wires through both surfaces; tests assert action availability via either dispatcher)
LatheChatterAnalysisEngine — lathe-specific chatter (different harmonic profile from mill)

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Hurco V11 emits a roughing program. Per-block forces from PPG-MS1 peak at 2,800 N at the corner; machine force ceiling is 2,500 N. Block-by-block S/F was sized assuming 60% engagement but actual is 78%.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms14: Program emits anyway. Operator runs it. Spindle stalls in the corner. Cutter chips. 45 min lost; one $80 endmill destroyed.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms14: Pre-emit gate runs all 6 predicates. machine_force_limit_validate fails (2800 > 2500). HARD BLOCK on shop_floor. Wizard shows red banner: 'Force exceeds machine ceiling at block 47 by 12%. Suggested fixes: derate Vc by 15% OR reduce ap from 5 mm to 4.2 mm OR change to a 4-flute insert.' Programmer accepts auto-fix; gate re-runs and passes; emit proceeds.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: Bad emissions are caught before reaching the machine, with a clear remediation suggestion.

units.title: PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine — assemble all 6 predicates as a single gate
units.scope: src/engines/PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine.ts — runs in PostProcessorPipelineEngine as stage 3.5; takes block-by-block force + spindle load + workholding context + thin-wall geometry; returns {verdict: PASS/WARN/BLOCK, failed_predicates[], suggested_fixes[]}.

units.title: Tier-aware HARD BLOCK / WARN routing
units.scope: Consume omega-thresholds.json (PPG-MS8); shop_floor → HARD BLOCK on any failure; production → HARD BLOCK on critical only; proven_out → WARN on critical; sim → WARN on all. Logged with provenance.

units.title: Auto-fix suggestion engine
units.scope: src/engines/PreEmitAutoFixSuggesterEngine.ts — for each failed predicate, computes 2-3 concrete remediation suggestions (derate Vc, reduce ap, change insert, RPM hop, add support, swap workholding). Suggestions are ranked by minimal cycle-time impact.

units.title: Wizard pre-emit verdict banner + accept-fix flow
units.scope: web/src/components/ppg/PreEmitVerdictBanner.tsx — red/yellow/green; lists failed predicates with explanations; one-click accept-fix re-runs the gate.

units.title: Pre-emit gate regression on 50-program corpus
units.scope: src/__tests__/PreEmitSafety.regression.test.ts — every program in the PPG-MS1 corpus runs through the gate; assert no false BLOCK on known-good programs and no false PASS on injected-fault programs (10 fault scenarios).

units.title: NaN/Infinity numeric guards + input validation early-reject layer
units.scope: Closes PPG-REAL-MS0/U-PPR04 + U-PPR05. Adds Zod numeric guards on every PostProcessorPipelineEngine boundary; rejects NaN/Infinity/negative-where-disallowed at input; structured error with offending field path. Wires into PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine as predicate #7.

units.title: Lathe safety predicate band (18 lathe-predicate actions (dual-wired in camDispatcher + turningDispatcher) routed through PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine)
units.scope: Extend PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine to load lathe-mode predicate set when domain=lathe: chuck_force (clamp adequacy), tailstock (counter-support), steady_rest (long-overhang), part_off_force (parting tool stress), lathe_collision_check (turret + chuck + tailstock envelope), lathe_swing_check (max OD vs swing), lathe_grooving_overhang, lathe_chip_thickness, lathe_boring_reach, lathe_drill_thrust, lathe_parting_force, lathe_beam_deflection, lathe_chip_breaking, lathe_peck_schedule, lathe_chatter_analysis, lathe_g71_type (G71 vs G72 vs G73 selection sanity), lathe_boring_taper_comp, lathe_springback_comp. Tier-aware HARD BLOCK on shop_floor. Plus G76 single-point threading via lathe_thread_schedule (already in turningDispatcher cam-routed via camDispatcher.ts), bar_feeder via mill_turn_bar_feeder action, live_tool via mill_turn_live_tooling action, sub_spindle via mill_turn_sub_spindle action — extend the lathe band to include the 4 mill-turn actions for bar-fed and sub-spindle synchronized lathe configurations.

units.title: WEDM safety predicate band (14 wedm-predicate actions (dual-wired in camDispatcher + edmDispatcher) routed through PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine)
units.scope: Extend PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine to load WEDM-mode predicate set when domain=wedm: wedm_safety_gate_evaluate (composite), wedm_unit_tag_evaluate (program units sanity), wedm_head_clearance_evaluate (top-head + bottom-head clearance), wedm_flush_adequacy_evaluate (flush pressure vs material thickness), wedm_thermal_release_evaluate (thermal stress release), wedm_dialect_verify (controller dialect syntax), wedm_predict_wire_break (Weibull breakage prob per pass), wedm_assess_surface_integrity (recast/HAZ/white layer), wedm_thin_wire_derate_summary (sub-0.1mm derate), wedm_kerf_overcut (corner overcut), wedm_wire_stress_analyze (tension safe envelope), wedm_wire_tension_optimize, wedm_wire_heating_safe_params (Joule heating limit), wedm_check_spec (recast ≤ spec). Tier-aware HARD BLOCK on shop_floor. Plus wedm_haz_predict + wedm_haz_stock_allowance + wedm_haz_compare actions for heat-affected-zone allowance gating at emit time (closes S05 HAZ gap — HAZ was leveraged in MS3 only, not gated at emit).

units.title: Domain dispatch within PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine (mill | lathe | wedm)
units.scope: Replace the mill-only predicate list with a domain-aware dispatch: domain detected from sidecar.machineClass (mill | lathe | wedm | grinder | laser); each domain loads its predicate band; cross-domain (mill-turn, EDM-with-mill-finish) loads union with conflict detection (e.g. lathe_chuck_force vs mill_workholding_verify cannot both apply to same setup). Conflict scenarios to test ≥3: (1) lathe_chuck_force vs mill_workholding_verify on mill-turn setup; (2) wedm_thermal_release_evaluate vs lathe_chip_breaking on EDM-roughed-then-lathe-finished part; (3) mill_collision_check vs lathe_collision_check on Multus B250IIW mill-turn (different envelope volumes). Adversarial: (a) sidecar with empty machineClass → must default to shop_floor band union; (b) sidecar with conflicting domain claims (e.g. mill+wedm in same setup) → must HARD BLOCK with explicit error.

completion_criteria: All 6 predicates wired into a single PreEmitSafetyPredicateEngine running as PostProcessorPipelineEngine stage 3.5
Tier routing honored: shop_floor HARD BLOCK on any critical failure; sim WARN only
Auto-fix suggester returns ≥2 ranked remediation suggestions for every BLOCK with ≥80% acceptance on operator UX test
Regression: 0 false BLOCKs on the 50-program known-good corpus; 10/10 injected-fault programs caught
Wizard verdict banner usable: operator can read + accept fix in <30s (UX test)
Lathe safety predicate band (18 actions) HARD BLOCKs on shop_floor when any critical predicate fails on Okuma B250 reference corpus
WEDM safety predicate band (14 actions) HARD BLOCKs on shop_floor when any critical predicate fails on MV1200R reference corpus
Domain dispatch correctly selects mill / lathe / wedm bands; mill-turn correctly loads union
Lathe band includes G76 + bar_feeder + live_tool + sub_spindle predicates with reference-corpus regression on Okuma B250 + Multus B250IIW mill-turn
WEDM band includes wedm_haz_predict + wedm_haz_stock_allowance gating at emit time
